title: Fourier transform of nonlinear images of self-similar measures: qualitative aspects
summary: The goal of this paper is to establish polynomial Fourier decay for images of self-similar measures $μ$ on $\mathbb{R}^k$ under sufficiently nonlinear real-analytic maps $f \colon \mathbb{R}^k \to \mathbb{R}^d$. For example, we prove that if $f$ is analytic on $\mathbb{R}^k$, its graph does not lie in an affine hyperplane in $\mathbb{R}^{k+d}$, and $μ$ is not supported in an affine hyperplane in $\mathbb{R}^k$, then the image measure has polynomial Fourier decay.
